title: Argentina's all-time top scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Argentina in official full internationals, to the 2026 World Cup final.

notes.Herminio Masantonio: Herminio Masantonio is just outside with 21.
notes.Jose Sanfilippo: Jose Sanfilippo is just outside with 21.
notes.Julian Alvarez: Julian Alvarez had 15 by the 2026 final.

checks: Wikipedia's records table, RSSSF (to 14 November 2025) and Transfermarkt checked against each other. Messi 125 and Lautaro Martinez 40 at 19 July 2026: RSSSF's 115 and 36 plus 10 and 4 in 2026 (Transfermarkt match reports and National Football Teams' 2026 table agree); Wikipedia's 42 for Lautaro on 3 October includes two goals in October 2026, outside the period. Aguero 41 and Higuain 31: Wikipedia, Transfermarkt and National Football Teams (RSSSF 42 and 32); 41 and 31 used. Batistuta 56 and Maradona 34: Wikipedia and RSSSF (Transfermarkt 55 and 33). Artime 24, Luque 22, Passarella 22: Wikipedia and RSSSF. Luque and Passarella tie for 10th, so they share it as a pool.
